basic_details.job_title: PAU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has published the Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) Notification 2026 on its official website. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) position on a contractual basis. Candidates holding a Bachelor's degree with Punjabi, a Master's degree in Punjabi, and a Matric-level certificate in the Punjabi language are eligible to apply offline. Interested candidates should submit their applications on or before 07 August 2026. The official notification, application form, and further recruitment details are available on the official website.

age_limit.age_details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.
age_limit.details: Age relaxation will be applicable as per the rules. Please refer to the official notification for specific details.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree with Punjabi, Master degree in Punjabi, Matric level certificate of Punjabi language.
qualification.details: Bachelor's degree with Punjabi subject with a minimum OCPA of 6.00/10.00 basis or 60% marks. Master's degree in Punjabi with a minimum OCPA of 5.50/10.00 basis or 55% marks. Must have passed the Matric level certificate of Punjabi language from the Punjab School Education Board or any other recognized Board (as first or second language).

salary_details.details: Rs. 35,000/- per month for M.A. Rs. 40,000/- per month for Ph.D.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the PAU Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) posts is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Punjabi with at least 60% marks and a Master's degree in Punjabi with at least 55% marks. Additionally, a Matric level certificate in Punjabi language is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) post ranges from Rs. 35,000/- per month for those with an M.A. degree to Rs. 40,000/- per month for those with a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with required documents to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the PAU Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Punjab Agricultural University located?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is located in Ludhiana, Punjab.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the position of Teaching Assistant (Punjabi) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and download the application form from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University: https://www.pau.edu.
